scenes.title: Key ideas
items: Rollups execute transactions off Ethereum and post data or proofs back to it.
Optimistic rollups assume transactions are valid unless challenged
ZK rollups post validity proofs, so native withdrawals can be faster.
scenes.vo: First, Rollups execute transactions off Ethereum and post data or proofs back to it. Next, Optimistic rollups assume transactions are valid unless challenged. Native withdrawals to Ethereum wait out a challenge window (about 7 days on major optimistic rollups). Then, ZK rollups post validity proofs, so native withdrawals can be faster. Also, Sequencer: the operator that orders transactions. Often a single operator today; if it goes down, the chain may pause. And finally, Escape hatches: most rollups let you force a withdrawal via Ethereum if the sequencer censors you. Know if yours does.

scenes.q: Why do optimistic rollup withdrawals take ~7 days?
scenes.a: The challenge window lets anyone dispute an invalid state before it's final.

scenes.a: The L2 may pause transactions until it recovers.
